# OverlayTile

One approved colour-overlay pairing: a rounded square fill centred on a rounded square ground.

`Gradnext.OverlayTile` · Color

## Use

```jsx
<Gradnext.OverlayTile />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gradnext.OverlayTile"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One approved colour-overlay pairing: a square fill on a square ground.

## Props (OverlayTileProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ground` | `"dusk" \| "white" \| "mist" \| "night"` | dusk = background-01, white, mist = white with periwinkle corners, night = rhino-950 with periwinkle glows. Default "dusk". |
| `fill` | `"yellow" \| "white" \| "periwinkle" \| "midnight"` | The overlaid square. Default "yellow". |
| `size` | `number` | Side in px. Default 160. |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name when the tile carries meaning. |
